# Hand Therapy

## the upper extremity specialists

### Hand Therapy at DPT

At Doctors of Physical Therapy, some of our locations include specialists in **Hand Therapy** who provide exceptional, personalized experiences for all our patients. We have clinicians who have obtained or are pursuing Certified Hand Therapist (CHT) certification.

CHT certification comprises a rigorous curriculum focusing solely on hand, arm and shoulder rehabilitation techniques. Our CHTs specialize in treating individuals with conditions affecting the hands and upper extremity. A qualified hand therapist can evaluate and treat any problem related to the upper extremity.

Our specialists are able to create **custom splints** that meet our patient’s physician requirements. These splints protect and support the affected area and help increase joint mobility as your injury or condition heals.

Each of our therapists work and communicate closely with attending physicians to create treatment plans that work for you and your life. Patients often begin their rehabilitation within days of office visits or post-surgical procedures.

## HAND AND WRIST DIAGNOSES:

- Boutonniere Deformity
- Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
- Headaches
- CMC Osteoarthritis
- Extensor Tendon Repair / Laceration
- List ItemFlexor Tendon Repair / Laceration
- Finger, Hand and Wrist Fractures
- Game Keepers Thumb
- Mallet Finger
- Swan Neck Deformity
- Trigger Finger
- Boxer’s fracture (Metacarpal Fracture)

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## ARM AND ELBOW DIAGNOSES:

- Bicep Tendonitis Rupture or Tear
- Cubital Tunnel Syndrome
- Arm and Elbow Fractures
- Tennis Elbow and Golfers Elbow
- Pronator Syndrome
- Radial Tunnel Syndrome

## Shoulder Diagnoses:

- Proximal Humerus Fracture
- Frozen Shoulder
- Bursitis Tendonitis
- Shoulder dislocation
- Shoulder impingement
- Shoulder instability
- Shoulder separation
- Torn Rotator Cuff

## Treatment techniques / procedures

- Custom Orthotic Fabrication (Static & Dynamic)
- Passive Range of Motion
- Active Range of Motion
- Joint Mobilization
- Modalities (Ultrasound, Heat, Cold, TENS, NMES, Iontophoresis)
- Targeted Muscle Strengthening
- Scar Care (Desensitization, Scar management)
- State-of-the-art equipment (BTE machine)

## Ready To Get Moving Again? Schedule Your Appointment Now!

No need to wait any longer to start feeling better! Get signed up now for an appointment now to get back to the life you love!

[Schedule Now](https://members.drsofpt.com/dpt/welcome)
